title: Giant Yo Seal Clicker
premise: A cute neon seal sits on top of a hidden giant "YO" / "Ё" letter, and the player taps repeatedly to hype the seal until the camera reveals the oversized glyph underneath.
interaction_model: Single-screen pointer/touch tapper with one primary action: tap anywhere outside UI buttons to increase score and trigger feedback.
objective: Reach 50 taps to trigger the reveal sequence and uncover the giant glowing letter beneath the seal.
progression: Start screen -> active tapping round with score feedback -> win trigger at target score -> camera zoom-out reveal -> end screen with replay.
theme: Cute neon animal meme toy with arcade-glow presentation and a typographic reveal gag.
mood: Playful, bright, cozy, silly, and lightly celebratory.
likely_audience: players who like cute animal humor
confidence_notes: High confidence that this is a clicker/tapper microgame because the only core input increments score directly on pointer down.
High confidence that the main payoff is the reveal of the hidden giant "YO" / "Ё" because the UI text, camera move, and win message all center on it.
Moderate confidence on deeper interpretation beyond novelty because the project is intentionally short and contains no longer-term progression systems.
recreation_prompt: Create a short single-screen browser tapper called "Giant Yo Seal Clicker" where the player starts on a polished neon-glass title card and then taps anywhere on the play field to pet or hype up a cute chubby cartoon seal. The entire game should be rendered on a full-screen canvas with a cyan-to-blue arcade gradient background, soft glowing orbs, and a cute white seal sitting near the center on top of a hidden giant typographic shape. Show a top HUD with a score counter like "0 / 50" and make every tap increase the score by exactly one while triggering juicy feedback: a tiny squash-and-bounce animation on the seal, a burst of bright particles, a short tap sound, and a brief reaction GIF overlay near the bottom. Start the round zoomed in on the seal so the hidden object is not fully visible. When the player reaches 50 taps, stop active input, pause the background loop, play a win sound, briefly show a celebratory GIF near the top, and animate the camera outward so the player finally sees that the seal was sitting on a giant glowing pink "YO" / Cyrillic "Ё" letter. Reveal large celebratory text explaining the discovery, then show an end card with an AGAIN button to restart the same loop. Keep controls simple for mouse and touch, preserve a playful silly tone, and make the whole experience feel like a cute neon novelty clicker with one satisfying reveal payoff.
